description: Регистър на издадените разрешения за таксиметров превоз на пътници is a dataset listed in Open Data Bulgaria, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by taxireg.uslugi.io. Coverage: BG. The portal shows the English title as "Register of authorisations issued for taxi passenger transport" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include превоз, пътници, разрешения, Балчик, таксиметров, регистър. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-open-data-bulgaria.
